ducktape.title: Ducktape CLI: install & configure
ducktape.reference: The terminal screenshot in step 3 shows: ducktape login --workspace <name> --region eu-west. The prerequisite callout is filled by JavaScript and reads: Requires Node.js 20 or newer.

tasks.instruct: How do I install Ducktape on Windows and connect it to my workspace in the EU?
tasks.execute: Write a PowerShell script that installs Ducktape on Windows, authenticates it, connects to the workspace 'acme' in the EU region, and verifies the setup.

pondhost.title: Pondhost: deploy a static site
pondhost.reference: The pond.toml image shows: [site] name = "my-site", publish_dir = "dist"; [build] command = "npm run build". The custom-domain steps (pond domains add <domain>, CNAME to edge.pondhost.net, `pond status` to verify) live on a separate Domains page.

tasks.instruct: How do I deploy my Vite app to Pondhost and serve it on docs.example.com?
tasks.execute: Produce the pond.toml file and the exact shell commands to deploy a Vite app to Pondhost for the first time, attach the domain docs.example.com, and verify it is live.

waddle.title: Waddle: set up SAML SSO
waddle.reference: The SAML settings image shows: ACS URL https://auth.waddle.app/saml/acs, Entity ID urn:waddle:sp, NameID format EmailAddress.

tasks.instruct: How do I set up SAML SSO for our Waddle workspace with Okta without locking anyone out?
tasks.execute: Produce the exact Okta SAML app settings (URLs, IDs, attribute mappings) and the ordered list of Waddle admin actions to enforce SSO safely.
